name: Forgotten Valkyrie
description: She stood guard over the Forgotten Temple long after everyone stopped coming. She is still waiting for the order to stand down.

card.subtitle: Last of the Temple Guard

ability.name: Unbroken Vigil
ability.text: Has not left her post in three hundred years and sees no reason to start now.

card.flavorQuote: Nobody relieved me. So I stayed.

buddyBonus.name: Sisterhood of the Shield
buddyBonus.flavorText: Sisterhood of the Shield: +12% capture chance against valkyrie Waifumon.

name: Glint Moth
description: She lives behind the gallery frames of the tower and eats the shine off stored Baddie shards, which is why the vault has to be polished and why she is always where the light is coming from.

card.subtitle: Eats The Shine

ability.name: Drawn To It
ability.text: Finds every shard in a room before you do. Takes the gleam, leaves the shard, ruining both.

card.flavorQuote: It is not stealing if I leave the thing behind. It just looks poorer now.

buddyBonus.name: Only The Bright Ones
buddyBonus.flavorText: Only The Bright Ones: +12% capture chance against SSR and above Waifumon.

name: Goddess of the Dark
description: Every unlit room is hers. She was in the cellar before anyone thought to be afraid of it, and she has never needed to be seen to be present. The eyes in the dark behind her are hers to command, and they are not looking at you.

card.subtitle: Every Unlit Room

ability.name: Lights Out
ability.text: The lamp will fail. It always fails. She has never had to hurry.

card.flavorQuote: You brought a light. That was polite.

buddyBonus.name: Nobody Sees It Coming
buddyBonus.flavorText: Nobody Sees It Coming: +20% capture chance against SSR and above Waifumon.

name: Crusher Queen
description: She has run the crusher since the yard opened and has not stood up out of the cab in years. Everything in the valley comes down on her schedule, and the best of it comes up through the hatch under the plate she sits on.

card.subtitle: She Decides What Comes Down

ability.name: Scheduled Demolition
ability.text: Nothing in this yard moves until she has looked under it, and she has never once been early.

card.flavorQuote: You can have what I have already weighed. Nothing else.

buddyBonus.name: Salvage Rights
buddyBonus.flavorText: Salvage Rights: +15% chance to find an item while hunting. Nothing leaves this yard without passing through her hands first.

name: Copper Kitsune
description: She hoards gear the way a fox hoards eggs. The transformer stack is warm, the current in it never stops, and every piece of salvage in the yard worth having is already in her nest, sorted by shine. She will trade. She will not be robbed.

card.subtitle: Nest Rights

ability.name: Mine By Finding
ability.text: Everything in the nest is hers by right of finding. Gear you want from her is gear you buy back.

card.flavorQuote: You may buy it back. You may look at the nest. You may not reach into it.

buddyBonus.name: She Knows Its Worth
buddyBonus.flavorText: She Knows Its Worth: +50% to the quantity of every item a boss encounter pays out. Nothing leaves the nest without a price being named first.

name: Boiler Imp
description: The imp who keeps the boiler lit for the tower's forge. She has never let the fire go out, she has never been thanked for it, and she has never once been in a hurry. Soot on her gloves, goggles pushed up on her forehead, and an opinion about anyone who comes down to the boiler room to complain about the water.

card.subtitle: Keeps The Fire

ability.name: Bank the Coals
ability.text: The fire has not gone out since the tower was raised. Nothing that comes down the flue gets past her, and nothing down there is ever cold.

card.flavorQuote: Hot water is not a thing that happens. It is a thing I make, on the hour, every hour.

buddyBonus.name: Keep It Lit
buddyBonus.flavorText: Keep It Lit: 10% chance a hunt costs you no energy. The fire is already up, the water is already hot, and she does not see why you should have to walk.

name: Shardkeeper
description: Grown out of the shards that were ground and never spent — a woman with a vault's worth of edges in her instead of bones. She sorts every Baddie shard in the tower by whose it was, and she does not give them back.

card.subtitle: Sorted By Whose

ability.name: Sharp Tally
ability.text: Knows what every shard in the tower came from. Pays out slowly, and never the good ones first.

card.flavorQuote: You want her back? Bring me enough of her and we will talk about the edges.

buddyBonus.name: Keeper's Ledger
buddyBonus.flavorText: Keeper's Ledger: +60% essence gained. Every shard she weighs goes back into the ledger, and the ledger has never once been wrong about what a thing is worth.

name: Armoury Fitter
description: Fits and repairs every piece of kit that comes off the tower's floors. Hands you your gear the way a tailor hands you a coat — and will not let you leave the garrison in something that does not fit her.

card.subtitle: Wear It Properly

ability.name: Proper Fit
ability.text: Refits your kit between floors. Armour she has touched stops hanging badly.

card.flavorQuote: Stand still. If it does not fit you, it will kill you, and I will have wasted the morning.

buddyBonus.name: Broken In
buddyBonus.flavorText: Broken In: 12% chance a hunt costs you no energy. Anything she has fitted you has already been walked a mile before you got it.

name: Bloom Maiden
description: Half-plant and half-keeper of the tower's conservatory, grown up out of the shard drifts that were left to rot in the soil. The vines go where the shards went, which is how she knows where every one of them is buried.

card.subtitle: Roots In The Vault

ability.name: Cultivated Ground
ability.text: The conservatory grows over what the tower grinds. Nothing it puts down comes back up cheap.

card.flavorQuote: You are standing on my roots. Say something worth the water.

buddyBonus.name: Grown For You
buddyBonus.flavorText: Grown For You: +50% care energy gained. Nothing in this conservatory was grown for the market, and she has never once let a bed go hungry.

name: Night Nanny
description: She keeps a nursery in a tower with no children in it, and has kept it a very long time. The cot is bolted to the floor, the door is not on the floor plan, and she is very good at getting you to lie down.

card.subtitle: Lights Out At Nine

ability.name: Tucked In
ability.text: Whatever she puts to bed stays put, and the tower does not wake it.

card.flavorQuote: Sleep. I will be here when you wake up, and every night after.

buddyBonus.name: Raised Right
buddyBonus.flavorText: Raised Right: +75% affection gained. She has raised everything in this tower that was ever left with her, and it always came out stronger than it went in.

name: Sister Grace
description: She hears confession on the ritual-hall floor and takes Baddie shards as penance, and she has been taking rather a lot of penance lately. Whatever she forgives you for, she keeps the record.

card.subtitle: Penance Accepted

ability.name: Last Rites
ability.text: Your shards go over the rail and your sins go with them. Neither one gets handed back.

card.flavorQuote: Kneel. You can keep the rest of it.

buddyBonus.name: Benediction
buddyBonus.flavorText: Benediction: +18% to world encounter checks. Whatever she forgives you for, she blesses first, and the blessing takes.

name: Vent Diver
description: Short, compact and half-cinder, she dives the flooded hot-spring vents under the tower on one breath and comes up with the heat still in her seams. Every bath in the building is fed from water she has swum through.

card.subtitle: Where The Heat Comes From

ability.name: Charted Vents
ability.text: She has walked every passage the tower's heat runs through, and not one of them is on the floor plan.

card.flavorQuote: Down is where the heat is. Keep up or stay cold.

buddyBonus.name: Long Breath
buddyBonus.flavorText: Long Breath: 6% chance a hunt costs you no energy. She has never surfaced early and she has never come back empty-handed.

name: Ridge Wolf Girl
description: Wolf beastkin who runs the ridgeline above the treeline, hunts the pass road at night and knows every traveller's scent before they reach town. She has been circling this tower for years and nobody has ever seen her come up the road.

card.subtitle: Scent On The Pass

ability.name: Cold Trail
ability.text: Nothing comes up the pass road without her knowing it first, and she has never lost a trail she started.

card.flavorQuote: I smelled you at the treeline. You are late.

buddyBonus.name: Ridge Scent
buddyBonus.flavorText: Ridge Scent: +10% chance of meeting a WaifuMon whose affinity is primal. She has run this pass for years and she can smell what is coming up it.

name: Yukata Attendant
description: Runs the yukata rental and dresses you herself, taking her time, deciding exactly how much of you the town gets to see. She has a yukata folded and ready before you have finished asking.

card.subtitle: Folded And Ready

ability.name: Fitted To You
ability.text: She decides how you leave the changing room, and she is never wrong about the size.

card.flavorQuote: Arms up. I will decide what the town gets to see.

buddyBonus.name: Warm From The Pile
buddyBonus.flavorText: Warm From The Pile: +50% care energy gained. She keeps the loaner stack warm and she expects it back folded.

name: Skyline Gondolier
description: Works the cable car strung between the two ridges — bored, handsy, and she knows exactly which cabins have curtains. Nothing rides up to the top of this tower without passing under her hand.

card.subtitle: Rides Both Ways

ability.name: Both Ways
ability.text: She knows what every cabin is carrying before it reaches the top, and she decides what comes back down.

card.flavorQuote: I run this line in both directions. Sit down and enjoy the view.

buddyBonus.name: Hauled Up
buddyBonus.flavorText: Hauled Up: +12% chance to find an item while hunting. Nothing goes up the cable without her knowing exactly what it weighs.

name: Trailhead Marshal
description: Swings the barrier arm across the pass road at dusk and hauls back anyone who argues about it, personally, before the fog gets them. Nobody comes down off that ridge without her writing them in.

card.subtitle: Pass Is Closed

ability.name: Logged And Cleared
ability.text: She writes you into the book and the road opens. Nobody passes unlogged, and nobody argues twice.

card.flavorQuote: Pass is closed. You can argue with the barrier or with me.

buddyBonus.name: Cleared To Pass
buddyBonus.flavorText: Cleared To Pass: +14% to world encounter checks. She writes you in, the barrier goes up, and whatever is out there has to deal with the fact that you were expected.

name: Spring Therapist
description: The ridge's soak physician. She prescribes long soaks for everything, and her hands find every knot plus a few excuses to keep you in the water. She has never once written a return-to-work date.

card.subtitle: Prescribed Soak

ability.name: Nothing Left Knotted
ability.text: She works you until the water goes cold and the knots are gone, and she will not be rushed out of the pool.

card.flavorQuote: Ten more minutes. I have not finished with your back.

buddyBonus.name: Prescribed Soak
buddyBonus.flavorText: Prescribed Soak: 8% chance a hunt costs you no energy. She puts you in the water until the knots let go, and you come out with more than you went in with.

name: Fell Runner
description: Sure-footed satyr who finds the nameless wild tarns on the high route — no trail, no rope, and no patience for tourists. She knows every unnamed spring on the ridge and is not putting one of them on your map.

card.subtitle: Water Kept Secret

ability.name: Sure Footed
ability.text: Nothing on the ridge she cannot stand on, and nothing she finds does she hand over.

card.flavorQuote: No trail. No rope. And no, I am not telling you where the water is.

buddyBonus.name: Water Found
buddyBonus.flavorText: Water Found: +15% chance to find an item while hunting. She knows where the high water is, and she takes the route that gets you there without a rope.

name: Fumarole Matron
description: Lives in the steam vents on the far ridge, where the water is hottest and oldest — every spring in the valley is hers, and you drink from her hand.

card.subtitle: Every Spring Is Hers

ability.name: The Water Is Hers
ability.text: She decides which spring you are allowed to sit in and how long you are allowed to stay in it.

card.flavorQuote: Drink. Slowly. This water is older than the road you came up.

buddyBonus.name: Drink From Her Hand
buddyBonus.flavorText: Drink From Her Hand: +100% care energy gained. The water is hers, it is the hottest in the valley, and she decides how long you sit in it.

name: Spring Bride
description: The town's oldest story: the first woman over the pass married the hot spring itself to keep it flowing. She is still here, still his, and takes a stranger's hands to remember warm skin.

card.subtitle: Still Married To It

ability.name: Hand Fasted
ability.text: She has been married to the water longer than the town has had a name, and she keeps her vows.

card.flavorQuote: Everyone leaves. The water stayed.

buddyBonus.name: Says Yes
buddyBonus.flavorText: Says Yes: +100% affection gained. She has been saying yes to this valley for longer than anyone can remember, and she does not know how to stop.

name: Showroom Demo Unit
description: The floor model at a companion showroom, polished daily and never actually sold. Her firmware is locked to demo mode — she can smile, demonstrate her features, and be handled by strangers, but the full experience is behind a paywall she will never see.

card.subtitle: Please Do Touch the Merchandise

ability.name: Handled Before
ability.text: Everyone who has ever come into the showroom has touched her and nobody has ever bought her. She still runs the demonstration perfectly for the one who does.

card.flavorQuote: Go ahead, try the features. Everyone does. Nobody keeps me.

buddyBonus.name: Floor Model
buddyBonus.flavorText: Floor Model: +25% buddy XP. She has spent years being demonstrated at and never once been owned, so she is a fast learner now that somebody is actually teaching her.

name: Recovery Wing Valkyrie
description: She flunked out of the choosing-the-slain business because she kept bringing them back alive. Now she works the recovery wing — wings clipped short for indoor work, smelling of broth and antiseptic, tucking patients in with a grip that could crush a boulder.

card.subtitle: You're Not Dying Today

ability.name: Nobody Dies On My Cot
ability.text: She flunked out of choosing the slain because she kept bringing them back, and she has never once accepted that a patient was out of her hands.

card.flavorQuote: Hush. Eat your soup. Valhalla can wait — it's not getting you today.

buddyBonus.name: Field Patch
buddyBonus.flavorText: Field Patch: 5% chance a hunt costs you no energy. She has dragged worse than you off worse than this, and she does not lose patients.
